title: Kevnnard · World entry
brief: Three lightweight entry loaders: letter-by-letter identity, a particle signature and an assembling world. Simulated previews only; production progress must follow real readiness.

artboards.title: Letterpress
artboards.tradeoff: Most minimal and strongest name recognition; less illustrative.

artboards.title: Particle signature
artboards.tradeoff: Recommended: a memorable signature with a bounded 2D particle field; modest extra drawing work.

artboards.title: World assembly
artboards.tradeoff: An architectural drawing explains preparation; more informative and less mysterious.

artboards.title: Particle world · combined
artboards.tradeoff: House-first hierarchy: a larger architectural drawing builds during 1–60%; only then does the smaller KEVNNARD particle signature appear underneath during 61–100%. One shared percentage; reduced motion shows a static composition.
